text:
leo: Quick alert from the morning KPI sweep — carousel CTR for the launch promo is down ~27% MoM, but demo requests are +14%. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/paid-vs-org looks contradictory. Anyone see attribution weirdness?

nina: I pulled raw GA and CRM. GA last-click shows Paid Social dropping, Organic landing pages up. CRM (first-touch) still credits the original campaign for many of the demo requests. Could be attribution window differences or cross-device fragmentation.

harper: Could also be our position-based/U-shaped model vs GA last-click. We're showing product marketing the single number and it's confusing. Can we surface multiple attribution models side-by-side on the KPI board? A simple three-column view (GA last-click | CRM first-touch | U-shaped) would help.

drew: Agreed. Also noticed a large cohort of mobile users where UTM is missing — we might be undercounting paid because our shortlink 302 to tracker drops params on iOS webviews. Quick SQL I ran:```SELECT source_type, count(*) FROM crm.leads WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND (utm_campaign IS NULL OR utm_campaign='') GROUP BY source_type;```returns ~480 null-campaign rows in 'webview' bucket.

leo: Oof. That's probably the split: demo requests coming from webview flows that strip UTMs, so CRM backfills via referrer or first-touch cookie when present. We should add both columns and a footnote about webview shortlink dropouts.

nina: For Friday's weekly KPI review can we: 1) add the three-attribution columns; 2) show a "sensitivity" row that lists how totals shift when using last-click vs first-touch; 3) highlight the webview cohort as a separate row.

harper: I'll update the dashboard tiles if ops can run a quick re-aggregate to include the new attribution columns. We should also add a tiny explanatory tooltip.

opsbot: opsbot: Re-aggregation job scheduled by @ops. Job id: reagg_4421. ETA ~45m. It will compute: GA_lastclick, CRM_firsttouch, U_shaped (40/20/40) per campaign and tag leads where user_agent LIKE '%WebView%'.

drew: After reagg completes, I'll run a diff and post a short table in this thread. If webview cohort explains most of the delta, short-term mitigation is to use the link with appended persistent param (utm_fallback=1) — small frontend update.

leo: Perfect — plan for Friday: dashboard shows three attribution columns + sensitivity row + webview cohort flagged. Ops reagg then Drew posts diffs, Harper adds tooltip, Nina narrates slide notes. Thanks all :rocket:

leo: Ping here once reagg done or if we need to change scope.
